mapper.sql: id, job_code, export_type, template_id, template_name, template_version, requester_id, student_id, system_task_id, filter_snapshot, column_snapshot, scope_snapshot, mask_policy_snapshot, request_reason, sensitive_flag, status, version_no, result_file_id, total_rows, processed_rows, failure_code, failure_message, request_source_hash, requested_at, reviewed_at, queued_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_export_job ( id, job_code, export_type, template_id, template_name, template_version, requester_id, student_id, system_task_id, filter_snapshot, column_snapshot, scope_snapshot, mask_policy_snapshot, request_reason, sensitive_flag, status, version_no, result_file_id, total_rows, processed_rows, failure_code, failure_message, request_source_hash, requested_at, reviewed_at, queued_at, started_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{job.id}, #{job.jobCode}, #{job.exportType}, #{job.templateId}, #{job.templateName}, #{job.templateVersion}, #{job.requesterId}, #{job.studentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{job.systemTaskId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{job.filterSnapshot}, #{job.columnSnapshot}, #{job.scopeSnapshot}, #{job.maskPolicySnapshot}, #{job.requestReason}, #{job.sensitive}, #{job.status}, #{job.versionNo}, #{job.resultFileId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{job.totalRows}, #{job.processedRows}, #{job.failureCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{job.failureMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{job.requestSourceHash}, #{job.requestedAt}, #{job.reviewedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{job.queuedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{job.startedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{job.completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_export_job WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY queued_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM sys_export_job WHERE status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND sensitive_flag = 1 ORDER BY requested_at, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_export_job WHERE status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND sensitive_flag = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_export_job SET status = 'EXPORTING', version_no = version_no + 1, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sys_export_job SET status = 'QUEUED', reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, queued_at = #{reviewedAt}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sys_export_job SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, completed_at = #{reviewedAt}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sys_export_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_file_id = #{resultFileId}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, processed_rows = #{processedRows}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXPORTING' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND #{processedRows} = #{totalRows}

UPDATE sys_export_job SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXPORTING' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}
